title: 全链哨兵 WebSocket 消息
description:
一帧一条 JSON 对象，`type` 是消息名，其余字段平铺在同一层。`messages.client` 是浏览器发给服务端的 227 种，`messages.server` 是服务端发给浏览端的 120 种。
每条的 `schema` 指向 `$defs` 里的 JSON Schema（draft 2020-12），`example` 是一个符合它的样例。
上行消息另有 `replies`（只回给发出消息的连接的消息）、`broadcasts`（发给所有连接的消息）、`failures`（处理失败时回的 `error` 文案）；
下行消息另有 `sentWhen`（什么情况下发出）。`domain` 是功能域，完整说明在 docs/contract/websocket/<domain>.md。
每种消息的完整说明在 docs/contract/websocket/ 下，先读 connection.md。

connection.gates: 握手和 HTTP 一样要过三道门：没有入口 Cookie 回 404，没有会话 Cookie 回 401，账号没接受授权承诺回 403。Cookie 随握手请求发送。
connection.heartbeat: 服务端每 25 秒 ping 一次，90 秒收不到 pong 就断开。客户端要回 pong（浏览器的 WebSocket 实现会自动回）。
connection.replaced: 只记最后一次登录。别处登录、退出登录或修改密码后，这条连接以关闭码 4001 关闭，原因分别是 session_replaced 和 session_expired。收到后重新登录再连接。
connection.unknown: 发来不认识的消息名，回 {"type":"error","message":"未知消息类型: <消息名>"}；发来不是 JSON 的帧，回一条 `error`。

## API 源码映射

### GET /api/orders/{id}：查订单

模块：订单

- 入口：`OrderController.getOrder`（/work/shop-api/src/main/java/com/shop/order/OrderController.java:42）
- 调用链：
  1. [service] `OrderService.find`（/work/shop-api/src/main/java/com/shop/order/OrderService.java:88）
  2. [repository] `OrderMapper.selectById`（/work/shop-api/src/main/java/com/shop/order/OrderMapper.java:23）
- 数据访问：
  - 读 `t_order`（id, user_id, status, amount）（/work/shop-api/src/main/resources/mapper/OrderMapper.xml:7）
- 权限校验：未发现
- 备注：整条调用链上没有找到登录、权限或资源归属的校验

### POST /api/orders/{id}/pay：订单支付

模块：订单

- 入口：`OrderController.pay`（/work/shop-api/src/main/java/com/shop/order/OrderController.java:50）
- 调用链：
  1. [service] `OrderService.pay`（/work/shop-api/src/main/java/com/shop/order/OrderService.java:96）

- 外部调用：
  - [http] https://pay.example.com/v1/payments（/work/shop-api/src/main/java/com/shop/order/pay/PayClient.java:20）
  - [mq] order.paid（/work/shop-api/src/main/java/com/shop/order/OrderService.java:110）：支付成功后通知发货

ThinkingLevel.description: Thinking/reasoning level for models that support it. Note: "xhigh" and "max" are only supported by selected model families. Use model thinking-level metadata from

criteria.description: One criterion per line; empty means the operator left them out.

SentinelMode.description: Who decides whether a bash command may run. `review` asks the operator, `ai` asks the gatekeeper model, `auto` runs it. `ai` is not a weaker `auto`: a judgment that fails is allowed through (so a dead endpoint cannot stall an unattended run), but a missing endpoint refuses the mode outright rather than silently degrading.

SentinelStateSnapshot.description: Snapshot of the runtime state sent on connect and after state changes.

allowedPrefixes.description: Command prefixes (first word) auto-approved this session, e.g. ["nmap"].

availableThinkingLevels.description: Levels the active model accepts, in ascending effort order.

compacting.description: Compaction (or branch summarization) is running for the active session. It blocks prompts, and a slow model can hold it for minutes, so the console has to show it and offer a way out.

compactionStartedAt.description: When the current compaction started, for the elapsed time; null when idle.

droidEnabled.description: Whether the viewed conversation mounts the Android toolset (per session).

gatekeeper.description: Which mode applies and how the gatekeeper model is doing.

goal.description: Persistent goal of the active session, with live counters; null when there is none.

iosEnabled.description: Whether the viewed conversation mounts the iOS toolset (per session).

messages.description: Serialized AgentMessage[] for the active session.

modeling.description: The modeling run in the active session, with live counters; null when this session is not modeling. The modeling tools are declared in every agent session; this says whether a run is in force here.

pendingApprovals.description: Bash commands awaiting an operator decision, oldest first.

preset.description: The preset agent the active session was created with; null means the default agent.

project.description: Active project; null means no project is selected and the chat is unavailable.

reportsEnabled.description: Whether the viewed conversation has opted into report submission and evidence tools.

runningSessions.description: Session ids with an active run (background included).

sessionStatus.description: Operator status of the active session, as a label the agent never sees.

subagents.description: Sub-agent runs of the active session, newest first, without their process steps.

subagentTotal.description: Total runs of the active session; `subagents` is only the newest page.

supervisor.description: Supervision of the viewed conversation; null when it was never armed.

supervisorConfig.description: Global supervision settings shown under 设置 → 模型.

thinkingLevel.description: Reasoning effort for the active session; "off" when the model has no reasoning.

SentinelGatekeeperView.description: Live gatekeeper state carried in every snapshot.

failures.description: Judgments that failed and were allowed through.

judgeResolved.description: The endpoint the 守门模型 role resolves to; null when nothing resolves.

lastSuccessAt.description: When the judge last answered; newer than `lastFailureAt` means it recovered.

sessionMode.description: Mode in effect for the active session (its override, or the global default).

sessionOverride.description: The active session's own choice; null means it follows the global default.

SentinelResolvedModelView.description: What a role resolves to right now, so the screen can show the effective endpoint.

followedMain.description: True when the role resolved through 主模型 instead of its own entry.

SentinelGoalView.description: A goal as the console shows it: the stored record plus live counters.

baseline.description: Usage when the goal started, so the bar can show what this goal cost.

blockerStreak.description: Consecutive rounds reporting the same blocker.

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria; empty means the operator left them out.

noProgressStreak.description: Consecutive rounds without a tool call.

roundLimit.description: Automatic continuations allowed. The initial run is not counted.

running.description: Whether the goal's session has a run in flight right now.

subagent.description: Sub-agent work of this goal. Shown for context; it does not consume rounds.

submitted.description: Findings submitted to the hub while this goal ran.

usage.description: Main-agent usage since the goal started.

SentinelGoalUsage.description: Token and cost counters. Cost is null when the endpoint reports no price.

SentinelGoalBlocked.description: The blocker report that stopped a goal.

streak.description: Consecutive rounds the same blocker was reported.

SentinelGoalCompletion.description: The evidence a completed goal carries.

findingsNote.description: Required when nothing was submitted: why the run found nothing to report.

submitted.description: Findings submitted to the hub during this goal, as verified by the runtime.

SentinelGoalCriterionResult.description: One acceptance criterion with the verdict given at completion.

SentinelGoalProgress.description: What the model last reported through `goal_progress`.

SentinelGoalRound.description: One round of a goal: the initial run, or one automatic continuation.

index.description: 0 is the initial run; continuations count up from 1.

SystemMessage.description: System instructions and tool declarations at one point in the transcript. The leading system message is the system prompt. Later system messages change it: `content` adds instructions from that point on, `sections` replace or remove named prompt sections, and `toolsAdded`/`toolsRemoved` change the tool set. Replaying every system message in order yields the current prompt and tools. Providers that accept system messages mid-conversation send each one in place; other providers rebuild the leading system message from the replayed state.

content.description: Instruction text. On the leading message this is the base prompt; later, additional instructions.

sections.description: Named, ordered prompt sections rendered verbatim after `content`. The leading message declares them; later messages replace sections by name, and `null` removes one. Keep each section self-delimiting (a tag, a heading) so the model can relate an update to the original. Avoid integer-like names; JSON objects reorder those.

AssistantMessageEvent.description: Event protocol for AssistantMessageEventStream. Successful streams emit `start` before partial updates and terminate with `done`. A stream may terminate directly with `error` when request setup fails before generation starts; after `start`, failures also terminate with `error`. Direct `streamSimple()` calls throw synchronously when request auth is missing. Updates and `done` must never appear before `start`. `partial` is the shared live response-so-far helper, not an event-time snapshot. Text and thinking blocks are empty when their `*_start` event is emitted and grow only through their corresponding `*_delta` events until the authoritative `*_end`. Redacted thinking may be complete at start and emit no deltas. Tool-call arguments at `toolcall_start` are provider-specific; `toolcall_delta` carries subsequent JSON updates.

Every tool call lands in exactly one bucket: - `ai` the gatekeeper judged it — bash and droid_shell in AI 审批, plus MCP and plugin tools while the MCP switch is on. The only bucket with a verdict, a latency and a token cost. - `human` 审批模式: the operator approved or rejected it in the queue. - `auto` nobody looked: 自动执行 mode, an allow-listed prefix, or a tool the judge does not cover (read, edit, write, …). The audit page shows the first bucket as 「AI 审批」 and the other two as 「自动审批」, which together cover every call exactly once.

text.description: Observation text; may be empty for a bare outcome.

vulnLabel.description: Set on the entry created by linking a hub finding.

key.description: null keeps the stored secret; omitted on add is an error.

SentinelAssetConfigView.description: The whole asset-mapping configuration as the console sees it.

sessionQueryLimit.description: Queries one session may send across all platforms; 0 means unlimited. The budget exists because all three platforms meter queries, and an agent working a large scope can burn a day's quota in minutes.

usable.description: How many platforms are usable right now (enabled, keyed, and verified).

SentinelAssetPlatformView.description: One platform as the settings screen shows it; the key itself never leaves the host.

baseUrl.description: Custom origin or reverse-proxy prefix; empty means the official platform URL.

enabled.description: Operator switch. Off means the platform's tool is not mounted at all.

hasKey.description: A key is stored. Only this fact is sent to the browser, never the key.

verified.description: The key was probed and the platform answered. A platform is only handed to the agent when this is true, so an unusable key never becomes a tool that fails on every call.

SentinelAssetStatus.description: The outcome of the most recent call to one platform, kept for the settings screen so a failure stays visible after the session that hit it is gone.

quota.description: Quota line as the platform reported it, e.g. "剩余 39366 点".

SentinelWebSearchKeyView.description: Web-search (Tavily) key-pool configuration. Unlike the asset platforms, the pool holds many keys of one provider and rotates them by remaining credits, so the view is a list rather than a fixed platform row.

tail.description: Last 4 characters of the stored key, so rows can be told apart.

usage.description: Credits left and the cap they relate to, when a usage probe has run.

SentinelPocFilters.description: List filters; every field is optional and they combine with AND.

SentinelPocSourceSave.description: Save payload: `id` absent creates a source; an empty header value keeps the stored one.

references.description: CVE ids extracted at import time.

sourceFile.description: File the template was imported from.

id.description: The template's own `info.id`, which imports dedupe on.

references.description: CVE ids extracted at import time.

sourceFile.description: File the template was imported from.

SentinelPocSource.description: One subscription source: a zip URL the operator subscribes to. Sync only upserts (by template id) and never deletes — the library grows, and removing a template stays a manual decision.

headerName.description: Optional single auth header (e.g. Authorization). Present = one is set; the value itself never leaves the server.

headerSet.description: True when the stored source carries a header value.

history.description: Recent sync outcomes, newest first (bounded server-side).

intervalHours.description: Hours between automatic syncs; 0 = manual only.

lastResult.description: Newest outcome, mirrored at the top of `history`.

SentinelPocSyncRecord.description: One sync outcome kept on the source.

trigger.description: "manual" = operator clicked; "auto" = the interval timer fired.

SentinelApiModelFilters.description: List filters; every field is optional and they combine with AND.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on title, target and source.

SentinelApiModelSummary.description: A run without the two bodies, for lists.

error.description: Why the run ended without a model, when it did.

sessionId.description: Session the run was started from; null when it could not be resolved.

source.description: The part of the source that was read: a repository, a directory, or the operator's own words. Empty when this part was not done.

submissions.description: How many submissions the run made; 0 means the agent never delivered.

target.description: What was restored from traffic: a base URL, a host, or the operator's own words. Empty when this part was not done.

SentinelApiModelStatus.description: Lifecycle of one modeling run. `modeling` is the only live state; `done` is the agent's own declaration, `manual` is the operator ending it, `failed` marks a run that ended before it delivered anything.

SentinelApiModelEvent.description: One line of a run's audit trail, with the counters as they stood at the time.

SentinelApiModel.description: One stored modeling run. It has two parts and either may be empty: the interface document the agent restored from traffic (`openapi`, `entities`), and what it read out of the project's source (`apis`, `logic`). Every run is a new record; history is never overwritten.

apis.description: The endpoints as the source shows them, in the order they were submitted.

error.description: Why the run ended without a model, when it did.

openapi.description: OpenAPI 3.x document, verbatim. It has no paths when interfaces were not restored.

sessionId.description: Session the run was started from; null when it could not be resolved.

source.description: The part of the source that was read: a repository, a directory, or the operator's own words. Empty when this part was not done.

submissions.description: How many submissions the run made; 0 means the agent never delivered.

target.description: What was restored from traffic: a base URL, a host, or the operator's own words. Empty when this part was not done.

SentinelApiSourceMapping.description: One endpoint as the source shows it. The four lists are always present and may be empty: an empty `authChecks` is the agent's finding that there is no check on this path, which is not the same as not having looked.

confidence.description: `verified` was read in the source; `inferred` is concluded from reading part of it.

method.description: Upper case (`GET`, `POST`, ...), or `ANY` where one handler serves every method.

path.description: The route as the source declares it, placeholders included: `/api/orders/{id}`.

SentinelCodeAuthCheck.description: Where an endpoint's path checks the caller: login, permission, or ownership of the record.

SentinelCodeLocation.description: A place in the source, as the agent read it. `file` is the path inside the project container (`/work/...`) and lines are 1-based. The console puts a submitted path into this form; it does not check that the file or the line exists, so a location is the agent's claim and nothing more.

SentinelCodeCallStep.description: One step of an endpoint's call chain, from the handler inward.

SentinelCodeDataAccess.description: A table an endpoint reads or writes, and where in the code that happens.

via.description: The function or mapper the access goes through, when that is not clear from the call chain.

SentinelCodeExternalCall.description: A call an endpoint's path makes to something outside the code base.

SentinelApiModelEntity.description: A business entity: the object the API is about (user, order, payment), not a schema of the document. It is what makes the result a business model rather than an endpoint list, and it is stored next to the OpenAPI document.

SentinelApiModelField.description: One field of a business entity the model inferred.

SentinelApiModelRelation.description: One relation between two business entities.

SentinelBusinessLogicModel.description: The business logic of the source: what it enforces, beyond what each endpoint does.

SentinelCodeApiDependency.description: A dependency between two endpoints that lives in the business, not in one call.

SentinelCodeEntity.description: A business entity as the code models it: most often a table or a domain class.

owner.description: Who owns the records: the entity or role whose rows these are.

table.description: The table or document store behind it.

kind.description: How the two are connected: `1:1`, `1:N`, `N:M`, or the code's own word for it.

SentinelCodeRule.description: One business rule: something the code enforces, or relies on, across endpoints.

apis.description: The endpoints the rule touches, each as `METHOD /path`.

id.description: Stable across submissions, so a corrected rule replaces the one it fixes.

subject.description: What the rule is about: an entity, an endpoint, an operation.

field.description: The column or field that holds the state.

initial.description: The state a new record starts in.

subject.description: What has the states: an entity, or an entity in a process (`订单`, `提现申请`).

effect.description: What the change writes, beyond the state itself.

guard.description: What must hold before the change is allowed.

trigger.description: What brings the change about, usually an endpoint: `POST /api/orders/{id}/pay`.

enabled.description: The viewed conversation's switch; device and token lists are global.

lanIps.description: Non-internal IPv4 addresses of the server, for the listen picker.

listen.description: The dedicated reverse listener, when it is bound.

listenConfig.description: What the operator picked (may differ from `listen` when it failed to bind).

idleMs.description: Runtime-only: milliseconds since the device's last frame (0 when fresh).

The gateway sets this once the last frame is older than its liveness window.

certPin.description: SHA-256 of the console's leaf certificate, for wss pinning.

IosJailbreakForm.description: Which jailbreak layout the device runs; paths and launchctl differ per form.

SentinelMcpExposure.description: Exposure of a server's tools, as the MCP extension accepts it.

SentinelMcpTransport.description: How a custom MCP server is reached. `stdio` spawns a command on the console host, outside the project container. `http` talks to a remote streamable-HTTP endpoint, and `sse` to the older HTTP+SSE one, where the server names the message endpoint on a long-lived stream.

SentinelMcpConfigView.description: The whole custom-MCP configuration as the console sees it.

mounted.description: Servers a session mounts right now (enabled, acknowledged, and within the tool budget).

path.description: Config file the entries are stored in, shown on the page.

permissionOn.description: The 权限 → MCP switch. Off means no server is mounted at all.

SentinelMcpServerView.description: One custom server as the settings screen shows it, editor fields included.

hostExecAcknowledged.description: stdio only: the operator accepted that the command runs on the console host. A server without it is stored but never mounted.

target.description: Command line for stdio, URL for http: the one-line summary of the row.

timeout.description: Per-request timeout in seconds; null means the extension's own default (60).

SentinelMcpStatus.description: The outcome of the last connection attempt, kept for the settings screen.

at.description: Epoch milliseconds of the attempt, or null when it was never connected.

error.description: Failure text as the connection or the transport reported it.

resources.description: Resources it listed at the last successful connect.

tools.description: Tools the server offered at the last successful connect.

SentinelMcpTestResult.description: One connection probe, with what the server offered when it answered.

detail.description: Technical detail, e.g. the response body excerpt or error cause.

instructions.description: Server instructions from `initialize`, when it sent any.

message.description: Human-readable summary in Chinese for direct display.

tools.description: Tool names the server offered, when it connected.

category.description: Optional vuln-category narrowing on top of the status filter.

SentinelCodeActivityFilter.description: Which slice of the project activity feed to read.

monitorId.description: An existing monitor lets the server reuse its stored token.

apiBaseUrl.description: Override the derived REST base, e.g. `https://ghe.example.com/api/v3`.

autoDispatchCategories.description: Categories eligible for auto-dispatch; null/empty means all categories.

cronExpression.description: Required when scheduleKind is cron; null/empty clears it.

scheduleKind.description: Omitted on update keeps the stored strategy.

token.description: Empty or omitted on update keeps the stored token.

SentinelVulnCategory.description: Coarse vulnerability class the judge must pick for a security verdict: web (injection, XSS, SSRF, auth bypass, path traversal, …), memory (overflow, OOB, UAF, double free, …) or other (crypto, DoS, info leak, …). Drives the activity filter and the per-monitor auto-dispatch allowlist.

SentinelCodeOneShotInput.description: A one-time scan of recent commits on the repository's default branch.

SentinelCodeScheduleKind.description: How a monitor decides when the next check is due.

SentinelCodeMonitor.description: One watched repository. Polling is branch-scoped and stateful: `baselines` maps each watched branch to the last commit already consumed, so a failed or capped check resumes where it stopped instead of rescanning history. apiBaseUrl.description: REST base, e.g. https://api.github.com or https://ghe.example.com/api/v3.

autoDispatch.description: Dispatch a confirmed finding to an engine without asking first.

autoDispatchCategories.description: When set, auto-dispatch only these vulnerability classes; null means all.

autoDispatchTags.description: Also require at least one matching detailed tag; null means all types.

checkState.description: Whether a queued/running job currently exists for this monitor.

cronExpression.description: Five-field cron expression in server local time; null in interval mode.

findingCount.description: Security verdicts that were not ignored.

host.description: Host as parsed from the URL, e.g. github.com or ghe.example.com.

intervalMinutes.description: Minutes between automatic checks when `scheduleKind` is interval; 0 = manual.

nextCheckAt.description: Next firing, computed for display; null while a check is due or scheduled mode is off.

oneShot.description: This record represents one historical scan and is never polled.

oneShotLimit.description: Number of recent commits requested by a one-time scan.

SentinelCodeImportState.description: Server-side progress of a bulk monitor import.

SentinelCodeCommit.description: One commit the monitor fetched, with the judge's verdict and the handoff state.

confidence.description: 0–1, the monitor model's own confidence; null before a verdict.

cve.description: CVE or GHSA id when the commit names one.

diff.description: Bounded unified diff used for judging, kept for the detail view.

duplicateOf.description: Another finding in the same monitor already covers this one.

engineId.description: Engine started for this finding, once dispatched.

error.description: Why the last dispatch failed; cleared by a successful one.

reproductionStage.description: Persisted progress, synchronized with the linked engineering run.

title.description: First line of the message, for lists.

vulnCategory.description: Required coarse class on a security verdict; null otherwise.

vulnTags.description: Validated detailed tags; an empty list means a finding still needs classification.

vulnType.description: Vulnerability class, e.g. "路径穿越" or "反序列化".

SentinelCodeCommitStatus.description: Where a security commit stands after the operator's or the monitor's action. "dispatching" marks a reproduce run in flight, so a page refresh (or a server restart recovery) still shows the truth instead of snapping back to "new".

SentinelCodeVerdict.description: What the monitor model said about one commit. `pending` means it was stored but not judged yet; `failed` keeps the commit for a retry instead of turning an endpoint error into a verdict.

detail.description: Extra outcome line, e.g. how many commits a check consumed.

SentinelCodeMonitorDetail.description: One monitor plus its commit history and recent checks, newest first.

SentinelCodeCheckLog.description: One executed (or interrupted) check, for the detail page's log.

error.description: Branch/API/model error, or the reason an interrupted run was closed.

findings.description: Security verdicts reached by this pass.

SentinelCodeCheckTrigger.description: What started a check; kept in the audit log.

SentinelCodeCheckJob.description: One queued or recently executed check request.

attempts.description: Starts do not count; this is how many runs were launched.

checkId.description: Check-log row produced by the latest attempt.

host.description: GitHub host, used for per-host concurrency.

nextRunAt.description: Earliest time the queue may start it, in epoch milliseconds.

SentinelCodeJobStatus.description: Queue lifecycle of a check request.

SentinelEngineCreateInput.description: Operator input when creating an engineering run.

gateMode.description: Defaults to `auto` when omitted, which is what engines predating it used.

presetIds.description: Preset agents the commander may use; empty or omitted means no restriction.

presetOptional.description: Whether a task may run without a preset; omitted means it may.

recordWorkLinks.description: Opt in to recording this engineering run's work links; off when omitted.

reportTemplateId.description: Omitted follows the project default; null explicitly selects no template.

schedule.description: When set, the engine is saved as scheduled instead of starting immediately.

targets.description: One target per line, `target [note]`; blank lines dropped.

SentinelEngineLimits.description: Per-engine knobs; per-task limits derive from these unless overridden.

concurrency.description: How many tasks of this engine may run at the same time.

maxRetries.description: Dispatch attempts allowed per target (the first one counts).

timeLimitMin.description: Wall-clock minutes per task; null means no time limit.

tokenLimit.description: Total tokens per task; null means no token limit.

SentinelEngineScheduleInput.description: Operator input for a schedule; the server fills phase/applied/finished fields.

SentinelEngineGateMode.description: How an engine's workers get their commands approved. Engineering mode is unattended, so `review` is not offered: a worker would park on an approval queue nobody is watching. `ai` routes every worker command through the gatekeeper instead.

SentinelEngine.description: An engineering run: a commander plus its targets, tasks, and report.

gateMode.description: How this engine's worker commands are gated; see SentinelEngineGateMode.

presetIds.description: Preset agents the commander may dispatch with. Empty means no restriction: the brief lists every enabled preset. A non-empty list narrows the choice, and `dispatch_task` refuses a preset outside it.

presetOptional.description: Whether a task may run without a preset, as the default agent. True is how every engine behaved before this switch existed, and it stays the default. report.description: Final report markdown, once the commander declared the engine done.

reproduction.description: Explicit reproduction conclusion, when this run reproduces a security fix.

schedule.description: One-shot schedule; null for engines created with "start now".

startedAt.description: When the commander first started; null while the plan is still waiting.

ReportTemplateSnapshot.description: Frozen when a conversation or engine applies a template.

CodeReproductionResult.description: Explicit commander conclusions; completion and finding counts are not proof.

SentinelEngineSchedule.description: Persisted plan for one engine; null when the engine was started immediately.

applied.description: Actions already applied, so a restarted scheduler never repeats them.

repeatDaily.description: Start a fresh engineering run each day after the prior run completes.

timezone.description: IANA zone of the operator when the plan was made; display only.

SentinelEngineScheduleAction.description: One step of a scheduled engineering run. The timeline is one-shot: the times are absolute epoch milliseconds, and `timezone` is carried only for display (the browser that created the plan, e.g. Asia/Shanghai).

SentinelEngineTarget.description: One line of the operator's target list: a target plus an optional note.

SentinelEngineTask.description: One task the commander dispatched. Executed by its own agent session.

attempt.description: Which dispatch attempt for its target this is; 1 is the first.

autoResume.description: The task was interrupted by a scheduled pause and should be continued on the next scheduled resume. A service restart clears this: safe restart policy leaves interruption recovery to the operator.

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria the commander attached; the worker's goal enforces them.

objective.description: Self-contained instructions for the worker, written by the commander.

pendingContinue.description: A requested continuation that has not started yet. While it is set and the task is queued, the next worker reopens the task's own session file instead of starting a new conversation.

presetId.description: Which preset agent this task runs as, fixed at dispatch. `presetName` is copied in rather than resolved from the preset library, so the board still shows what a finished task ran as after the preset is deleted or renamed.

sessionId.description: pi session id of the worker, once it exists.

vulns.description: Findings submitted to the hub while this task ran.

workspace.description: Directory inside the project work dir this task owns.

SentinelEngineTaskContinue.description: A commander-requested continuation waiting for a worker slot. It is stored on the task row, not in memory, so a service restart while it is queued does not silently drop the instruction.

criteria.description: Extra automatic rounds; empty means keep the goal's existing criteria.

instruction.description: What the worker should do next, on top of its existing conversation.

roundLimit.description: Additional continuation rounds to grant, not a total.

SentinelEngineTaskStatus.description: Lifecycle of one engine task. Paused means interrupted (e.g. a restart).

token.description: Empty on an edit keeps the stored token.

package.description: The uploaded zip, base64. The host extracts and builds it.

ui.description: Null when the plugin ships no frontend.

args.description: Optional --build-arg values, e.g. a mirror for the base image.

context.description: Build context, relative to the plugin root.

default.description: Pre-filled value; `null` means the field starts empty.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Per-request budget of an MCP call, in milliseconds.

startupTimeoutMs.description: How long the host waits for the health endpoint while the container starts.

capAdd.description: Extra Linux capabilities, e.g. `NET_RAW` for a scanner that needs raw sockets.

memory.description: Docker size string, lower case, e.g. `512m` or `2g`.

SentinelPluginToolHint.description: A tool as advertised before install; the running MCP server remains authoritative.

entry.description: Container path of the entry document, e.g. `/ui/index.html`.

protocol.description: Bridge protocol; only 1 is understood for now.

sidebar.description: Author's suggestion to offer a sidebar entry; the operator still opts in.

title.description: Title shown in the console's frame around the iframe.

icon.description: Icon under /ui/, e.g. `/ui/icon.svg`; empty falls back to the generic icon.

label.description: Sidebar label; falls back to the UI title or plugin name.

SentinelPluginsView.description: Everything the plugin center page renders.

problems.description: Hosts that did not answer, one line each.

SentinelPluginHostView.description: A plugin host as the console lists it. The token is never part of the view: saving a host without one keeps the stored token.

local.description: Discovered from a `plugin-host --local` state file on this machine.

SentinelPluginView.description: One installed plugin on one host.

configured.description: Config keys that have a stored value.

enabled.description: The console-side switch; off means its tools are not mounted.

pinned.description: Pinned to the console sidebar by the operator.

values.description: Stored values of non-secret fields; secrets only appear in `configured`.

SentinelPluginState.description: Runtime state of one installed plugin, as the host reports it.

SentinelOfficialPluginView.description: One bundled official plugin, as listed before installation.

sizeBytes.description: Zip size, for the "why is this slow" hint.

SentinelPluginArtifact.description: One file under a plugin's artifacts directory.

customStrategyId.description: Set when the operator picked a saved custom strategy.

note.description: Optional operator note, capped at 200 characters.

strategies.description: Multiple selections; takes precedence over the legacy singular fields.
